description: Traffic Lights is a dataset listed in Ballarat open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by City of Ballarat. This dataset describes the location of traffic lights in the City of Ballarat. Coverage: Ballarat, Victoria. The portal files it under Transport, Roads & Planning. Its keywords are traffic. The portal shows 60 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2024-12-12 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY 3 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/au/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-ballarat-vic-gov-au-portal.
